name: open-html
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/page.html") with html4
XMLNodeInfo d
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: exists
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLExists r
XMLExists {d, r}
XMLClose d
XMLExists r

name: exists-removed
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLRemove b
XMLExists b
XMLClose d

name: display-html4
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
XMLDisplayXML d with html4
XMLClose d

name: display-html-document
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/page.html") with html4
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLDisplayXML d with html4
XMLClose d

name: change-set-xml-text-node
script: set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml") set r to XMLRoot d set n to XMLChild (XMLFind r name "note") index 1 XMLSetXML n to "replaced text" XMLCount (XMLFind r name "note") XMLDisplayXML d XMLClose d

name: change-append-text-mixed
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLAppendText " end" at (XMLFind r name "note")
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: error-none
script:
set d to XMLOpen from string "<a/>"
XMLError
XMLClose d

name: doc-save-html
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/page.html") with html4
XMLSave d in (POSIX file "$TMP/save.html") with html4
XMLClose d
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/save.html")

name: doc-save-string-path
script:
set d to XMLOpen from string "<a/>"
XMLSave d in "$TMP/string-path.xml"
XMLClose d
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/string-path.xml")

name: doc-xinclude
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/include.xml")
XMLXInclude d
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: c14n-nodelist
script: set d to XMLOpen from string "t" XMLc14n d nodelist (XMLXPath d with "//i") XMLClose d

name: transform-stylesheet-writes
script:
set d to XMLOpen from string "<a/>"
set r to XMLTransform d with "<xsl:stylesheet version='1.0' xmlns:xsl='http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform' xmlns:exsl='http://exslt.org/common' extension-element-prefixes='exsl'><xsl:template match='xsl:stylesheet'/><xsl:template match='/'><exsl:document href='$TMP/given.txt' method='text'>written</exsl:document><r/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>" as string
XMLClose d
{r, readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/given.txt")}

name: transform-pi-stylesheet-writes
script: set d to XMLOpen from string "]>written" try XMLTransform d as string on error number n XMLClose d error number n end try
